messages:
Priya Kapoor: Heads up — HelixCare onboarding saw recurring latency spikes during peak onboarding traffic. Customer flagged renewal concern; they asked for SLO alignment and whether credits apply. @Jared Liao @Emilia Ortiz

Jared Liao: Got it. can you paste the alert link? want to see windows and stacks.

Priya Kapoor: https://internal.metrics/helixcare/alerts — p95 drifted from ~420ms to ~1.2s in three 20–40m windows yesterday evening. uptime remained ~99.92% though.

Emilia Ortiz: I pulled traces — looks like batch-worker queueing on their dedicated pool coinciding with ETL jobs. infra team is tweaking the autoscale policy now, ETA ~2h for the patch.

Sam Chen: Quick contract check: HelixCare SLOs are p95 latency <500ms and monthly uptime >=99.9%. Credits are payable for "sustained degradations" per contract, but wording is vague on short p95 spikes.

Priya Kapoor: Contract clause: "Sustained degradation = p95 > target for >6 hours within a 30-day window." My read: current blips don't automatically trigger a credit, but we should still be transparent and propose a remediation plan + optional goodwill credit.

Emilia Ortiz: Recommend we: separate transient blips (<5m) from sustained; keep p95 as customer-facing SLO; use p99 internally for alerting. Also propose adding a canary throttle for onboarding ETL to avoid queue storms.

Jared Liao: I'll export hourly telemetry and produce a CSV of affected windows. adding a short incident summary with traces.

Priya Kapoor: Draft customer-facing note (please edit): "Hi HelixCare — during onboarding on Apr 2 we observed intermittent latency spikes that impacted a subset of requests. We've mitigated the cause (batch queueing), applied autoscale adjustments, and attached an incident summary + telemetry. Per contract, credits apply for sustained degradations; based on our analysis we estimate a provisional credit at $X, subject to final review. Would you like a call to walk through details?"

Sam Chen: Suggestion: don't state $X. Instead include the precise formula and the exact time windows. e.g., attach table + formula so credits are transparent: ```credit = round(min(1.0, (affected_minutes / (30*24*60))) * monthly_commit, 2)```

Emilia Ortiz: I'll write the postmortem + a 1-page runbook explaining safe batch concurrency limits for onboarding (EOD). Also add a short remediation step to the onboarding checklist.

Priya Kapoor: Action items:
- Emilia: postmortem + runbook (EOD)
- Jared: telemetry CSV + affected windows (by EOD)
- Sam: legal/finance confirm credit formula + whether we can offer goodwill credit while we investigate (EOD)
- Priya: finalize customer email and propose call times once numbers are in

OnboardBot: Reminder set for 2026-04-05 09:00 to follow up with HelixCare.

Emilia Ortiz: I'll also add a note to the renewal-risk tracker: https://notion.redwood/renewal-risk — mark HelixCare as "monitoring" for 2 weeks.

Sam Chen: OK to send the draft after we have the CSV. Priya, ping me and I'll loop in finance. :thumbsup:

Priya Kapoor: Will ping when the CSV + postmortem are attached. Thanks everyone!
